frontier.hypothesis: The v0/v1 coloring swap (cross-block arm-value pseudo forced to v1 instead of v0) is still the entire visible residual, but its exact conflict source (why it conflicts with hardreg 2 despite the mask-compute pseudo dying at the branch) is unexplained.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 global-alloc allocates a pseudo to a hard register only if it doesn't conflict with that register's existing live ranges at any program point; the arm-value pseudo's conflict list includes hardreg 2, meaning some other point in its live range overlaps a v0-live-range this session did not identify.
